title: agent-kv — vLLM + LMCache KV Benchmark
description: TTFT, throughput, KV cache hit rates, NVMe IO and queue depth for the agent-kv benchmark stack on gfx1201.

panels.title: Throughput
panels.description: Inference throughput metrics — requests per second and token generation rates.

panels.title: Requests / s
panels.description: Completed inference requests per second (HTTP 200 responses).

panels.title: Token Throughput
panels.description: Prompt and generation token throughput in tokens per second.

panels.title: Queue Depth
panels.description: Number of requests in flight or waiting in the vLLM scheduler queue.

panels.title: Latency
panels.description: End-to-end latency metrics for inference requests.

panels.title: TTFT — Time To First Token
panels.description: Time from request receipt to the first output token — dominated by prompt processing and KV cache lookup.

panels.title: TPOT — Time Per Output Token
panels.description: Average time per generated token after the first: (E2E − TTFT) / (output_tokens − 1).

panels.title: E2E Request Latency
panels.description: Total end-to-end latency from request receipt to final token.

panels.title: Request Queue Time
panels.description: Time requests spend waiting in the vLLM scheduler queue before being scheduled.

panels.title: Prefill vs Decode Phase Latency
panels.description: Phase-split request latency. High prefill latency relative to decode indicates cache misses are dominating TTFT.

panels.title: KV Cache — vLLM + LMCache
panels.description: vLLM GPU KV cache state, LMCache tier fill ratios, hit rates, and cache tier attribution.

panels.title: vLLM GPU KV Cache
panels.description: Fraction of GPU VRAM currently used by the vLLM KV cache pool.

panels.title: LMCache External Hit Rate
panels.description: Fraction of prefix tokens served from LMCache (external KV store) rather than recomputed.

panels.title: LMCache L1 Fill Ratio
panels.description: LMCache L1 (host RAM) fill ratio. Eviction watermark is 0.8 by default — red threshold indicates active eviction pressure.

panels.title: LMCache External Hits vs Queries
panels.description: Absolute token counts: LMCache hits vs total queries per second (vLLM external prefix cache counters).

panels.title: Cached Prompt Tokens (Prefix Cache)
panels.description: Prefix KV tokens served from vLLM's internal GPU cache (APC) — reuse within a single vLLM instance across requests.

panels.title: Requests Waiting By Reason
panels.description: vLLM scheduler wait reasons: 'capacity' = GPU KV pool full; 'kv_transfer' = async KV fetch from LMCache pending; 'deferred' = intentionally deferred.

panels.title: vLLM Cached Tokens By Tier
panels.description: Stacked area: prefix tokens served from each cache tier per second. 'external (LMCache)' is the cross-instance KV path; 'GPU (device)' is vLLM internal APC.

panels.title: EventBus Health
panels.description: LMCache OTel EventBus health. Non-zero dropped events/s means the observability pipeline is lossy and all counters silently under-count. Subscriber exceptions indicate callback errors that may corrupt metric counts.

panels.title: GPU↔CPU Transfer Bandwidth (L0↔L1)
panels.description: PCIe/XGMI bandwidth actually consumed by KV block transfers between GPU (L0) and host RAM (L1). p95 sustained near hardware limit indicates PCIe is the bottleneck.

panels.title: Block Device Throughput
panels.description: Read and write throughput for the selected block device in bytes per second.

panels.title: Block Device IOPS
panels.description: Read and write I/O operations per second for the selected block device.

panels.title: Block Device Latency (ms)
panels.description: Average I/O service latency in milliseconds for the selected block device.

panels.title: AMD GPU — amd-smi-exporter
panels.description: AMD GPU hardware metrics from the amd-gpu-exporter running as a host service on port 9200 (scrape: host-gateway:5000).

panels.title: GPU Utilisation
panels.description: GFX engine and UMC (memory controller) activity percentage from the AMD SMI exporter (host service, port 5000).

panels.title: VRAM Usage (MiB)
panels.description: Total and used VRAM in MB from the AMD SMI exporter — watch used VRAM to detect OOM pressure.

panels.title: GPU Power (W)
panels.description: Average socket power in watts from the AMD SMI exporter.

panels.title: GPU Temperature (°C)
panels.description: GPU junction temperature in Celsius from the AMD SMI exporter.

panels.title: LMCache Server + Coordinator
panels.description: LMCache MP server and coordinator internals — cache tiers, prefetch, key directory.

panels.title: LMCache Store / Retrieve Rate
panels.description: LMCache L1 (host RAM) chunk store, retrieve, and eviction rates in chunks per second.

panels.title: LMCache Cache Occupancy
panels.description: L1 (host RAM) actual memory usage in bytes and fill ratio (right axis, 0–1). L2 NVMe tier utilisation in bytes.

panels.title: LMCache Coordinator — Key Directory
panels.description: LMCache coordinator key-directory: chunk placements per tier (left axis) and bytes tracked per tier (right axis, bytes unit).

panels.title: Request-Level Cache Hit Rate (LMCache 0.5.7+)
panels.description: Token-level cache hit rates. 'APC+LMCache combined' = request_hit_tokens / prompt_tokens (includes GPU APC, denominator is full prompt). 'LMCache only' and L1/L2 split use requested_tokens as denominator.

panels.title: L2 NVMe Throughput — LMCache View
panels.description: LMCache's own measurement of L2 NVMe read/write throughput (GB/s) with in-flight I/O queue depth overlaid on the right axis.

panels.title: L2 Prefetch Activity (MP Server)
panels.description: LMCache MP server L2 prefetch pipeline: chunks loaded per second, requests in flight, and failure rate.

panels.title: Coordinator Chunk Hit Rate
panels.description: Coordinator-side chunk lookup hit rate (found/requested) and prefetch key hit rate.

panels.title: LMCache Servers Registered
panels.description: Number of LMCache MP server instances currently registered with the coordinator. Should be 1 for a single-node stack.

panels.title: L1 / L2 Failure Rates
panels.description: L1 allocation and read failures plus L2 prefetch failures. All series should be flat-zero in a healthy system.

panels.title: L1 Eviction Loop Health
panels.description: L1 eviction loop liveness (ticks/s) and watermark-crossing trigger rate. Triggered/s rising indicates sustained L1 pressure above the 0.8 eviction watermark.

panels.title: LMCache Lookup Early Exits By Reason
panels.description: Lookups aborted before probing the cache. 'no_gpu_context' indicates vLLM/LMCache GPU context mismatch (misconfiguration, not a cache miss).

panels.title: KV Block Lifecycle — GPU, L1, L0 (requires --kv-cache-metrics)
panels.description: Block and chunk lifetime histograms. vLLM panels require --kv-cache-metrics on vllm serve. LMCache panels require --metrics-sample-rate > 0 (default 0.01).

panels.title: vLLM GPU KV Block Lifecycle
panels.description: GPU KV block lifecycle: allocation-to-eviction lifetime, idle time before eviction, and gap between reuses. Short reuse gap = good workload locality. Requires --kv-cache-metrics.

panels.title: LMCache L1 Chunk Lifecycle
panels.description: LMCache L1 (host RAM) chunk lifecycle histograms. 1% sampled. 'evict-reuse gap' shows time from eviction to next access — large values indicate premature eviction.

panels.title: LMCache GPU (L0) KV Block Lifecycle
panels.description: LMCache's view of GPU (L0) KV block lifecycle. 1% sampled. Compare with vLLM GPU block panel (Panel 80) — these two see the same blocks from different instrumentation paths.

panels.title: System — CPU / Memory / Network
panels.description: Host-level CPU, memory, and network metrics from node-exporter.

panels.title: CPU Utilisation
panels.description: Host CPU utilisation. High values on vLLM or LMCache workers can indicate I/O or coordination bottlenecks.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Host RAM usage — LMCache L1 tier consumes a fixed allocation configured by L1_SIZE_GB.

panels.title: Network Throughput
panels.description: Host network interface throughput. KV block transfers between containers use the Docker bridge.

panels.title: LMCache Logs
panels.description: LMCache mp.store / mp.retrieve / mp.lookup_prefetch spans collected via OTLP → Alloy → Tempo. Enable tracing with --enable-tracing --otlp-endpoint http://alloy:4317 on the lmcache server (already set in docker-compose).

panels.title: LMCache Server Logs
panels.description: Live logs from LMCache server and coordinator containers.

panels.title: Logs — Loki
panels.description: Docker container logs collected by Alloy and stored in Loki. Use the Service filter to narrow by container. Click a log line's TraceID to jump to its span in Tempo.

panels.title: Container Logs
panels.description: Live container logs from all docker-compose services. Narrow with the Service dropdown above.
